description: [Increment 1: Assumptions] Chapter 1: introduction, aim of the work and thesis statement in thesis.md
[Increment 1: Assumptions] Chapter 2 (Part A): Background literature review on anomaly detection and bio-signal processing using `background_researcher`. Output: section content for thesis.md.
[Increment 1: Assumptions] Chapter 2 (Part B): SOTA discovery on multi-feature ensemble detectors using `discoverer_researcher`. Output: section content for thesis.md.
[Increment 1: Infrastructure] Configuration module with experiment parameters, seeds, and signal generation settings in src/config.py
[Increment 2: Method] Synthetic Bio-Signal Generator module for creating multi-channel telemetry with injected anomalies in src/data/synthetic_generator.py
[Increment 2: Method] Unit tests for SyntheticGenerator in tests/test_synthetic_generator.py
[Increment 2: Method] Baseline Univariate Z-Score Detector module in src/baselines/z_score_baseline.py
[Increment 2: Method] Unit tests for ZScoreBaseline in tests/test_z_score_baseline.py
[Increment 2: Method] Proposed Multi-Feature Robust Ensemble Detector module in src/models/robust_ensemble_detector.py
[Increment 2: Method] Unit tests for RobustEnsembleDetector in tests/test_robust_ensemble_detector.py
[Increment 3: Experiment] Experiment entrypoint script that runs the baseline and ensemble on synthetic data, computes metrics, saves results to CSV/JSON in src/experiments/run_benchmark.py
[Increment 3: Visualization] Plotting script to generate comparison figures from results in src/plots/plot_results.py
[Increment 3: Experiment] Execute run_benchmark entrypoint to produce results/results.csv and figures/accuracy_plot.png. Target is the execution module; harness handles file output.
[Increment 3: Writing] Chapter 3: Methodology - Description of the proposed robust ensemble detector and baseline.
[Increment 3: Writing] Chapter 4: Experimental Setup - Synthetic data generation details, parameters, and evaluation metrics.
[Increment 3: Writing] Chapter 5: Results and Analysis - Reporting metrics from results/results.csv, comparing ensemble vs baseline.
[Increment 3: Writing] Chapter 6: Conclusions - Thesis statement verification, limitations, and future work.
